fatal_blockers: Private-row overlap composition of the 18 Gen-2/3 survivors is dead in the tested form: every one of the 5832 ordered pair/overlap/polarity systems admits a nonzero integer kernel move of squared norm 4 supported entirely inside one clause. The Gen-3 isolation certificate provably depends on fixing all three marginals; freeing even one unshared marginal restores the elementary 001+100-010-011-type cheat. Any proposal that reuses these survivors with private syndrome rows and shared-marginal identification only is excluded.

The proposed mutation (a local block whose nonzero circuits change EVERY variable marginal) does not by itself escape composition: a joint move supported on BOTH clauses can shift the shared marginal equally on each side, preserving the shared equality while unshared marginals are free. Certifying the local property alone would repeat the Gen-2/3 pattern of a local fact that dies at composition; the composition test with cross-clause support and a norm bound above 4 is the actual gate.

No amplification or dimension-gap mechanism exists anywhere in the obstruction map after five generations. Even a fully composing local obstruction yields only a constant additive squared-norm gap, and the target requires factor n^c; this must be named as an unresolved blocker for the whole survivor-based line, not deferred again.
